extra.golden_response:
Correct answer: Ionic bond

The electronegativity difference between Na (0.93) and Cl (3.16) exceeds ~1.7, so electron transfer dominates over sharing. Na+ and Cl- form an ionic lattice; there is no discrete molecule with a shared pair.
